name: agent-workflows
description: This repository is its own marketplace: it hosts the agent-workflows plugin from the same tree it develops it in, so the placed copy and the tested copy are one thing.

plugins.name: agent-workflows
plugins.description: Carries one piece of work from a remark in a session to merged: file the issue, claim it, do it, judge whether it is actually done, open the change request, land it. Every step stops for a person, and the same gates cover READMEs and the files an agent reads. Needs `gh` or `glab`, authenticated.
